mapper.select: SELECT count(BPL.point_mac) as num, BPL.point_mac as mac FROM base_point_log BPL RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BP.point_mac = BPL.point_mac and BP.company_id = #{id} WHERE 1=1 and date_format(BPL.time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') > #{startTime} and date_format(BPL.time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') < #{endTime} and BPL.is_on = 0 GROUP BY BPL.point_mac

SELECT round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as fan, round((count(if(BLD.purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as purifier, BLD.point_mac as mac FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BP.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE BLD.yyyymmdd = #{format}

SELECT count(BPP.id) FROM ${tablePurifier} BPP WHERE BPP.bu_lampblack_id in( SELECT BLD.id FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BP.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE BLD.yyyymmdd = #{format} )

SELECT count(BPP.id) as num, BPP.point_mac as mac FROM ${tablePurifier} BPP WHERE BPP.bu_lampblack_id in( SELECT BLD.id FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BP.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE BLD.yyyymmdd = #{format} ) and BPP.second_voltage is not null and BPP.second_voltage < 10

SELECT IFNULL(SUM( BPP.output_power = 0 and BPP.power_open_status = 0 and BPP.power_protect_status = 10 and BPP.power_circuit_protect = 0 and BPP.power_overtemp_protect = 0 ),0) as num, BPP.point_mac as mac FROM ${tablePurifier} BPP WHERE BPP.bu_lampblack_id in( SELECT BLD.id FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BP.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE BLD.yyyymmdd = #{format} )

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 1 THEN 0 END),0) as a1, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 2 THEN 0 END),0) as a2, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 3 THEN 0 END),0) as a3, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 4 THEN 0 END),0) as a4, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 5 THEN 0 END),0) as a5, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 6 THEN 0 END),0) as a6, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 7 THEN 0 END),0) as a7, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE alarm_type WHEN 8 THEN 0 END),0) as a8 FROM base_company_type WHERE amount>50 and fid_region = #{fidRegion} and is_on = 0
and DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{format}

SELECT b.id as id, b.name, count(b.name) as num, date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') as time FROM base_company_type b WHERE 1=1 and date_format(b.create_time,'%Y-%m') = #{format} and b.is_on = 0 and b.fid_region = #{fidRegion} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY b.id ASC

SELECT b.id as id, b.name, count(b.name) as num, date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') as time, date_format(b.updata_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as clearTime FROM base_company_type b WHERE 1=1 and date_format(b.create_time,'%Y-%m') = #{format} and b.fid_region = #{fidRegion} and b.is_on = 1 GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY b.id ASC
